contentPattern.structure: header row + feature rows (label + per-column Yes/No/value cells)

suitableFor: feature comparison tables (rows = features, columns = product/plan options)
Yes/No/value matrices comparing account or plan types (e.g. HSA/HRA/FSA)
any tabular data with a header row and repeating labeled data rows
notSuitableFor: repeating image/text card grids (use cards variants)

notes: NEW variant for the topic-hub-subnav template, introduced by the Spending Accounts coverage-gap page. The representative depression page has no table, so no existing table variant existed (only the vanilla 'table' block, similarity < 80% since no comparison-purpose table variant was present). decorate() is the vanilla Block Collection table decorator (first row -> thead, remaining rows -> tbody); it uses only generic table element selectors, so no base-block JS class names required renaming. Source column order is HSA, HRA, FSA. Some cells carry superscript footnote markers ([2] on 'Funded by') that reference page-level disclaimers.
